terminals.name: emulators
terminals.description: Builds the Cloud Functions bundle and serves the Firebase Functions emulator on port 5001 (Emulator UI on 4000).
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; cd /workspace/apps/functions && bun run build && cd /workspace && ./node_modules/.bin/firebase emulators:start --only functions --project naamkaran-407d7

terminals.name: web
terminals.description: Runs the React Router (Vite) SPA dev server on port 5173, wired to the Functions emulator.
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"; cd /workspace && bun run dev --filter=web
